context:
Goal: the phone's Orphaned card form passes its accessibility audit, with no real contrast problem hidden.
Problem (rule): Apple's audit flags "Contrast failed" on two elements of the ready Orphaned composer, on 2 of 2 tries in run 42653870499: the "Save envelope" button and the "1 card" count. A designer measured both from the colour tokens. Save is card on ink at 12.17:1, and the count is inkSoft on card at 5.24:1. Both clear the 4.5 floor. Decision audit-skips-measured-flags allows only skips you name, so a new skip needs your word.
Based on (measured): the two pairs measure 12.17:1 and 5.24:1 (lane pro-ui-main-reds designer, 2026-11-09 12:01 CST; mockup on branch lane/orphaned-composer-contrast at 99e1b30).
Based on (read): debt tally-audit-contrast-flags; the audit samples pixels and flags pairs above 4.5:1 some of the time.
Based on (ruling): audit-skips-measured-flags; you named skips for Cancel, Edit and Discard on this same form.
Departs from: main audit-skips-measured-flags skips Cancel, Edit and Discard on the Orphaned composer — option a adds Save and the card count, contrast check only.
Meanwhile: both stay red under debt orphaned-composer-contrast, and lane pro-ui-main-reds works on the other reds.

options.gain: The Orphaned composer audit goes green, and the colours that measure clear stay as they are.
options.how: The composer audit skips only the contrast check, only on those two elements. The count first gets an id so the skip can name it. Every other check stays on.
options.label: Add named contrast skips for Save and the card count
options.lose: The audit stops checking contrast on two more elements.

options.gain: No new blind spot in the audit.
options.how: Roadmap step orphaned-composer-colours goes ahead: a designer and a builder adjust the two colours and rerun the audit until it is green.
options.label: No skip: change the colours until the audit passes
options.lose: Colours that already measure clear change to chase a likely pixel-sampling flag, and each try costs a simulator run.

ref: decision audit-skips-measured-flags (audit skips only for measured false flags); debt orphaned-composer-contrast (the ready Orphaned composer fails contrast); debt tally-audit-contrast-flags (the audit flags pairs above 4.5:1); step pro-ui-main-reds (the iPhone UI test reds on main)
title: The Orphaned composer's Save button and card count fail Apple's contrast audit, but their colours measure clear. Add two named skips?
